title: Itron, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Itron, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026 disclosing that an unauthorized third party gained access to certain corporate systems on April 13, 2026. The company activated its cybersecurity response plan, notified law enforcement, and took remediation actions. No unauthorized activity was observed in customer-hosted systems, and operations have continued in all material respects. The company does not currently believe the incident has had or is reasonably likely to have a material impact.
key_points: Itron, Inc. disclosed a cybersecurity incident on April 13, 2026 involving unauthorized access to certain corporate systems
The company activated its cybersecurity response plan and launched an investigation with external advisors
No unauthorized activity was observed in customer-hosted systems; operations continued in all material respects
Itron expects a significant portion of direct costs to be reimbursed by insurers
The company does not currently believe the incident has had or is reasonably likely to have a material impact
The company is evaluating what legal filings and regulatory notifications may be required
